errors.text_span: и са подредени в низходящ ред според честотата на посочване
errors.evidence: The bars are not sorted in descending order based on their values. For example, the bottom bar is 8%, the one above it is 19%, and the one above that is 10%.
The horizontal axis does not have a label. The percentage symbol '%' is part of the data labels next to each bar, not a label for the axis itself.

errors.text_span: но цветовете не са свързани с определени групи, а са разпределени по реда на категориите
errors.evidence: The colors are systematically used to group the data. Red bars represent values of 10% or higher, while blue bars represent values below 10%. The description incorrectly states that the colors are not linked to groups.

errors.text_span: и са разположени във визуално низходящ ред според честотата на посочване
errors.evidence: This is a repetition of a previous error. The bars are not sorted in descending order by value. The values from bottom to top are 8%, 19%, 10%, 7%, 14%, etc., which is not a descending sequence.
